title: 00450 - P119A/004506
models: Tüm VAG Grubu Modeller (Audi, VW, Seat, Skoda, Porsche)
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
symptoms: Reduced fuel economy and engine performance
commonCauses: Faulty Fuel Pressure Sensör Okuma Değerleri (G247)
Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri and/or Connector(s) from/to Fuel Pressure Sensör Okuma Değerleri (G247)
Exhaust Leak (sounds strange, but check for one!)
stepByStepSolution: Değiştirin / Yenileyin:  Fuel Pressure Sensör Okuma Değerleri (G247)
Kontrol edin:  Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri and/or Connector(s) from/to Fuel Pressure Sensör Okuma Değerleri (G247)
Kontrol edin:  fuel injectors for leak-down
Fix exhaust leak if one is found.
technicalNotes:
The Fuel Pressure Regulator Valve (N276) or Fuel Metering valve (N290) on the HPFP can fail.
(N276) Fuel Pressure Regulating Valve resistance should be approximately 1 to 5 Ω *
(N290) Fuel Metering valve resistance should be approximately 0.8 to 5 Ω *
(* always refer to repair manuals for specific values for your engine)
